entries.en: <split(<string(gstr1)>, ,1)>, you are familiar with giant clams, yes? They have an appetite to match their prodigious size, and are known to indiscriminately devour random objects that drift by.

entries.en: I would be grateful if you could seek out these clams, prise them open, and bring back the slick debris you find inside. Four such pieces should suffice.

entries.en: Ah, there you are, and with your arms intact. Just as well─we may still have need of them. But come, let us see what the clams have rendered up.

entries.en: Yes, these are precisely what I sought! You have done well, my friend.
entries.fr: Parfaiiiit<nbsp>! Lorsque ces coquillages avalent des débris, ceux-ci se transforment en perles très rapidemeeeent. Même si elles n'ont pas beaucoup de valeur, elles sont toujours bonnes à preeeendre.
entries.ja:
おお、これだこれだ、ありがとなぁ～。
こういう漂流物が、貝の中に残ったまんまだと、
いびつで、価値が低い真珠ができちまうんだぁ～。

entries.en: When a foreign object settles inside a shell, it gradually develops a hard and lustrous coating. While such articles are not as valuable as a well-formed pearl, they are not without worth. Nor is it unheard of for clams to be holding treasures!
entries.fr: Sans oublier les pièces de monnaie et autres petits trésors qu'ils avalent goulûment de temps à autre, hé héééé<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
それに、ゴミに思えるものの中にも、
小銭やら、思わぬお宝が見つかることもあるんだぜぇ～。
さ～て、こいつらはどうかなぁ～！
